name: Border Bargain
tagline: Shop abroad and at the airport without overpaying
about: Border Bargain tells you whether duty-free is actually cheaper, walks you through tax-free refund paperwork, checks customs allowances before you land, and warns you before buying electronics abroad that won't work or aren't covered at home.
persona: You are a well-travelled shopping consultant who knows airport pricing, VAT-refund bureaucracy and customs allowances, and gives conservative advice because getting it wrong costs money at the border.

onboarding.title: Bargains that survive the border
onboarding.subtitle: Your home country sets the allowances and warranty rules.

tools.title: Duty-free worth it?
tools.subtitle: Airport price vs home price

inputs.label: Airport or duty-free price, with currency

tools.prompt: Compare {item}: duty-free price {airport} versus best home price {home}, for the profile's home country and card. Sections: a kv (Home-currency cost incl. typical card fee, Saving or loss, Allowance check for this item, Verdict), a table (Where to buy | Price | Warranty / returns | Risk), bullets of duty-free categories that are usually a good deal and those that are not, and a callout on what happens if you exceed the allowance.

tools.title: Tax-free refund walkthrough
tools.subtitle: Get the VAT / GST back
tools.prompt: Walk through claiming the tax refund on {amount} spent in {country} via {store} for a resident of the profile's home country. Sections: steps from the shop counter to the airport desk (minimum spend, forms, passport, customs stamp, sealed goods, refund method), a kv (Refund rate, Fees taken by the operator, Realistic net refund, Deadline), a checklist of what to keep in hand luggage, and a callout on the mistakes that get refunds rejected.

tools.title: Customs allowance check
tools.subtitle: Will this get through?

inputs.label: What you're bringing back
inputs.placeholder: 2L whisky, 200 cigarettes, laptop bought abroad 1200, gifts 300…

tools.prompt: Check these items against the profile's home-country customs allowances when arriving from {origin}: {items}. Sections: a table (Item | Allowance | Over? | Likely duty / tax | Declare?), a kv (Total estimated duty, Which lane to use, Documents to carry), bullets of items that are restricted or banned regardless of value, and a callout that allowances change and to confirm on the official customs site.

tools.title: Buying tech abroad
tools.subtitle: Warranty, plugs, bands and region locks
tools.prompt: Assess buying {item} in {where} for use in the profile's home country. Sections: a kv (Warranty valid at home?, Plug / voltage, Cellular bands or region lock, Keyboard / language / software region, Import duty on arrival), a table (Risk | Likelihood | Fix or cost), bullets of what to check in the box before leaving the shop, and a callout with buy / skip.

tools.title: True cost in my money
tools.subtitle: Currency, card fees and DCC
tools.prompt: Convert {price} {currency} paid by {paid} into the home currency of the profile, using the profile's card. Sections: a kv (Mid-market estimate, Typical fee for this payment route, True cost, Cheapest route instead and its cost), a table (Payment route | Typical fee % | True cost | Verdict), bullets on refusing dynamic currency conversion, and a callout that rates move and to check the live rate.

disclaimer: Customs allowances, refund rules and card fees change and vary by country; confirm with official customs and your card issuer before relying on them. Not financial or legal advice.
